def factor_tail_semivar_volsync_v1(df):
    """Volume-confirmed bounded tail semivariance asymmetry."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    vol_weight = vol_ratio.clip(0.5, 2.0)
    down_ret = ret.where(ret < 0)
    up_ret = ret.where(ret > 0)
    down_var = (down_ret ** 2 * vol_weight).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    up_var = (up_ret ** 2 * vol_weight).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    spread = down_var - up_var
    total = down_var + up_var
    factor = spread / total.replace(0, np.nan)
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_tail_semivar_volsync_v1"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_tail_semivar_volsync_v1"]
